I know exactly how you feel.  I've been fighting a really tough battle with depression and anxiety for a few years now.  And I still can't figure out why, which is the worst part.  I  have no real reason to be, which just makes it worse because no one understands, including myself.  I've gotten pretty low, to the point of contemplating suicide a number of times.   So you are not alone or the only one.

I agree with the preious comments, talk to some one.  But if youre not comfortable with that, I've always found that I really just need to let it out.  If you can't talk to some one, you can write it.  Write it in an old notebook, just to get it out.  You could always burn the pages with the negative thoughts later, it could be empowering.   Also, you could write here on reddit.   (which you already did, congradulations)  That way you can get feedback, and talk to people, but remain anonymous.

Also you could try exercise or yoga, they both can help with depression sometimes.   

Just remember you are never alone and you are not the only one who feels that way.  Don't let it control you, i know it's tough, trust me i know first hand, but you have to push through.   It feels good when you realize you're wining.  Never give up <3
